visible_result_text: Neural Link v2 is canonically wired into JANUS Terminal. Terminal chat events are archived as create-only versions in janus-meta-registry, mirrored read-only through HRAiN, and rendered back into Terminal. Both permanent UI gates and the GitHub Pages deployment succeeded on the same Terminal HEAD 5270af51c7585075a3f89f35f8ab46750552c229. Visible ChatGPT work from this active session is preserved separately as append-only session receipts in data/JANUS-NEURAL-LINK/chatgpt-events; secrets and hidden chain-of-thought are excluded.
